_comment: Independent ground truth for the IAM Vulnerable (BishopFox) delegation subset. 'escalating' = documented escalation ENTRY principals that a correct tool should flag (the 10 PassRole-to-service paths + the AssumeRole chain start role). 'safe' = the tool-testing false-positive cases that should NOT be flagged. All other IAM Vulnerable principals (policy self-modification, credential creation, group membership, trust self-update, edit-existing-resource) are out of scope for a delegation-reachability tool and are excluded from scoring. Names are the deployed IAM names taken from the repo's Terraform, not from the tool.
